name: Free Movement of Goods
description: Aligning Ukrainian product standards, technical regulations, and conformity assessment with EU norms. Screening completed September 2025; chapter part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market).

name: Freedom of Movement for Workers
description: Establishing rights for Ukrainian workers in the EU and vice versa, including mutual recognition of professional qualifications. Part of Cluster 5 (Resources, Agriculture & Cohesion).

name: Right of Establishment and Freedom to Provide Services
description: Opening markets for businesses and service providers, including financial, postal, and professional services. Part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market).

name: Free Movement of Capital
description: Liberalising capital flows, harmonising rules on foreign investment, and aligning anti-money-laundering frameworks. Part of Cluster 5.

name: Public Procurement
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals), opened at the first Intergovernmental Conference in June 2024. Ukraine has reformed ProZorro, its procurement system, which is widely praised as a model for transparency.

name: Company Law
description: Harmonising corporate legislation, accounting standards, and corporate governance requirements with EU company law. Screening completed 2025.

name: Intellectual Property Law
description: Strengthening IP protection including patents, trademarks, copyright, and enforcement mechanisms. Screening completed 2025.

name: Competition Policy
description: Bringing state aid rules and antitrust enforcement in line with EU competition law. Screening completed 2025.

name: Financial Services
description: Aligning banking, insurance, and investment regulations with EU financial services directives. Screening completed 2025.

name: Information Society and Media
description: Updating rules on electronic communications, audiovisual media services, and digital single market alignment. Screening completed 2025.

name: Agriculture and Rural Development
description: Reforming agricultural policy, food safety standards, and rural development programs to meet Common Agricultural Policy standards. Part of Cluster 4.

name: Food Safety, Veterinary and Phytosanitary Policy
description: Implementing EU food safety standards, sanitary controls, and phytosanitary measures across the food chain. Opened as part of Cluster 4 (Green Agenda & Sustainable Connectivity).

name: Fisheries
description: Aligning fisheries management, conservation, and control measures with the EU's Common Fisheries Policy. Screening completed 2025.

name: Transport Policy
description: Harmonising road, rail, air, and inland waterway transport rules, including safety standards and market access. Part of Cluster 4.

name: Energy
description: Ukraine joined ENTSO-E (European electricity grid) in March 2022. Active negotiations on aligning the energy market, renewables legislation, and nuclear safety with the EU Energy Community acquis.

name: Taxation
description: Harmonising VAT, excise duties, and direct taxation with EU tax acquis and OECD standards. Part of Cluster 3 (Competitiveness & Inclusive Growth). Screening completed 2025.

name: Economic and Monetary Policy
description: Aligning macroeconomic frameworks, central bank independence, and preparing for eventual eurozone integration. Part of Cluster 3.

name: Statistics
description: Ukraine has fully aligned statistical methodology with Eurostat standards. Ukraine's State Statistics Service now produces comparable data across economy, society, and environment indicators.

name: Social Policy and Employment
description: Updating labour law, health and safety at work, and social dialogue mechanisms to meet EU standards. Part of Cluster 3.

name: Enterprise and Industrial Policy
description: Improving the business environment, supporting SMEs, and aligning industrial policy with EU competitiveness goals. Part of Cluster 3.

name: Trans-European Networks
description: Integrating Ukrainian transport and energy infrastructure into Trans-European Networks (TEN-T and TEN-E). Part of Cluster 4.

name: Regional Policy and Coordination of Structural Instruments
description: Building capacity to implement cohesion policy, manage structural funds, and reduce regional disparities. Part of Cluster 5.

name: Judiciary and Fundamental Rights
description: Core chapter of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals), opened June 2024. Covers judicial reform, Constitutional Court reform, anti-corruption institutions (NABU, SAPO, HACC), and protection of fundamental rights.

name: Justice, Freedom and Security
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals), opened June 2024. Covers border management, migration rules, asylum policy, anti-money laundering, and police and judicial cooperation.

name: Science and Research
description: Ukraine is fully associated with Horizon Europe since 2022, participating in EU research funding on equal terms with member states. Strong academic and institutional links across EU research networks.

name: Education and Culture
description: Expanding participation in Erasmus+, aligning higher education with Bologna Process, and cultural cooperation. Part of Cluster 3. Screening completed 2025.

name: Environment and Climate Change
description: Implementing EU environmental directives on water, air, waste, biodiversity, and aligning with the European Green Deal commitments. Part of Cluster 4.

name: Consumer and Health Protection
description: Strengthening consumer rights enforcement and aligning public health and pharmaceutical regulations with EU standards. Part of Cluster 2. Screening completed 2025.

name: Customs Union
description: Modernising Ukrainian customs procedures, IT systems, and aligning with the EU Customs Code. Part of Cluster 3.

name: External Relations
description: Aligning foreign policy instruments and trade agreements with Common Commercial Policy. Part of Cluster 6 (External Relations).

name: Foreign, Security and Defence Policy
description: Deepening participation in Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP) and Crisis Management. Part of Cluster 6.

name: Financial Control
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals), opened June 2024. Establishing public internal financial control systems and aligning with EU audit and accountability standards.

name: Finance and Budgetary Provisions
description: Preparing administrative capacity to manage EU budget contributions and structural fund financing. Part of Cluster 5.

name: Institutions
description: Reviewing institutional arrangements, translation capacity, and preparedness for EU institutional participation. Part of Cluster 6.

name: Other Matters
description: Covering transitional arrangements, derogations, and remaining technical issues. Part of Cluster 6.
